Community Trust Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ-CTBI) achieved earnings for the third quarter 2026 of $25.9 million, or $1.43 per basic earnings per share, compared to $29.6 million, or $1.64 per basic share, earned during the second quarter 2026 and $23.9 million, or $1.33 per basic share, earned during the third quarter 2025. Total revenue for the quarter was $1.2 million above prior quarter and $8.2 million above prior year same quarter. Net interest income for the quarter increased $0.2 million compared to prior quarter and $5.5 million compared to prior year same quarter, and noninterest income increased $1.0 million compared to prior quarter and $2.7 million compared to prior year same quarter. Our provision for credit losses for the quarter increased $6.4 million from prior quarter and $5.3 million from prior year same quarter. Noninterest expense decreased $0.9 million compared to prior quarter and $0.3 million compared to prior year same quarter. Earnings for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 were $82.7 million, or $4.58 per basic share, compared to $70.8 million, or $3.93 per basic share, for the same period prior year.


**3rd Quarter 2026 Highlights**


- Net interest income for the quarter of $61.1 million was $0.2 million, or 0.3%, above prior quarter and $5.5 million, or 9.9%, above prior year same quarter, as our net interest margin decreased 17 basis points from prior quarter but increased 3 basis points from prior year same quarter.
- Provision for credit losses at $9.2 million for the quarter increased $6.4 million from prior quarter and $5.3 million from prior year same quarter.
- Noninterest income for the quarter of $18.6 million was $1.0 million, or 6.0%, above prior quarter and $2.7 million, or 16.9%, above prior year same quarter.
- Noninterest expense for the quarter of $36.5 million was $0.9 million, or 2.4%, below prior quarter and $0.3 million, or 0.7%, below prior year same quarter.
- Our loan portfolio at $5.3 billion increased $177.9 million, an annualized 13.8%, for the quarter and $509.0 million, or 10.6%, from September 30, 2025.
- We had net loan charge-offs of $6.6 million, an annualized 0.50% of average loans, for the quarter compared to $0.9 million, an annualized 0.07% of average loans, for prior quarter and $2.7 million, an annualized 0.23% of average loans, for the third quarter 2025.
- Our total nonperforming loans at $22.5 million at September 30, 2026 decreased $7.3 million for the quarter and $2.2 million from September 30, 2025. Nonperforming assets at $27.7 million decreased $5.6 million for the quarter and $1.8 million from September 30, 2025.
- Deposits, including repurchase agreements, at $6.0 billion increased $86.1 million, an annualized 5.7%, for the quarter and $370.7 million, or 6.5%, from September 30, 2025.
- Shareholders’ equity at $877.3 million decreased $14.5 million, an annualized 6.4%, for the quarter but increased $46.0 million, or 5.5%, from September 30, 2025.

Net interest income for the quarter of $61.1 million was $0.2 million, or 0.3%, above prior quarter and $5.5 million, or 9.9%, above prior year same quarter, as our net interest margin, on a fully tax equivalent basis, decreased 17 basis points from prior quarter but increased 3 basis points from prior year same quarter. Our quarterly average earning assets increased $240.5 million, an annualized 3.7%, from prior quarter and $553.9 million, or 9.0%, from prior year same quarter. Our yield on average earning assets decreased 5 basis points from prior quarter and 10 basis points from prior year same quarter, while our cost of funds increased 14 basis points from prior quarter but decreased 23 basis points from prior year same quarter. Our ratio of average loans to deposits, including repurchase agreements, for the quarter was 86.2% compared to 87.2% for prior quarter and 85.6% for same quarter prior year. Net interest income for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 at $180.7 million was $19.9 million, or 12.3%, above same period prior year.


**Provision for Credit Losses**


Our provision for credit losses at $9.2 million for the quarter increased $6.4 million from prior quarter and $5.3 million from prior year same quarter. Of the provision for the quarter, $5.8 million was attributable to the allowance for credit losses, with an additional expense of $0.6 million recognized in the provision for unfunded commitments. The increase in the provision was the result of the increase in net charge-offs in addition to the significant loan growth we experienced during the quarter. Provision for credit losses for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 at $14.3 million was $4.7 million above same period prior year.

The variances in securities gains resulted primarily from changes in the valuation of our equity securities. Noninterest income for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 of $51.7 million was $4.6 million, or 9.9%, above prior year same period.

Noninterest expense for the quarter of $36.5 million was $0.9 million, or 2.4%, below prior quarter and $0.3 million, or 0.7%, below prior year same quarter. The quarter over quarter decrease primarily resulted from a $1.7 million decrease in the cost of our group medical and life insurance, included in employee benefits, partially offset by increases in salaries ($0.3 million), data processing expense ($0.2 million), and legal and professional fees ($0.2 million). The year over year decrease for the quarter primarily resulted from a $0.5 million decrease in data processing expense offset by a $0.2 million increase in legal fees. The decrease in the cost of group medical and life insurance year over year was offset by increases in salaries and bonuses. Noninterest expense for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 of $110.4 million was $3.8 million, or 3.5%, above prior year same period.


**Balance Sheet Review**


CTBI’s total assets at $7.1 billion increased $72.2 million, or 4.1% annualized, for the quarter and $423.4 million, or 6.4%, from September 30, 2025. Loans outstanding at $5.3 billion increased $177.9 million, an annualized 13.8%, for the quarter and $509.0 million, or 10.6%, from September 30, 2025. The increase in loans for the quarter included a $80.9 million increase in the commercial loan portfolio, a $53.0 million increase in the residential loan portfolio, and a $46.8 million increase in the consumer indirect loan portfolio, partially offset by a $2.8 million decrease in the consumer direct loan portfolio. CTBI’s investment portfolio at $1.1 billion increased $60.1 million, an annualized 22.6%, for the quarter and $74.4 million, or 7.1%, from September 30, 2025. Deposits in other banks decreased $178.1 million for the quarter and $164.0 million from September 30, 2025.

Deposits, including repurchase agreements, at $6.0 billion increased $86.1 million, an annualized 5.7%, for the quarter and $370.7 million, or 6.5%, from September 30, 2025. CTBI is not dependent on any one customer or group of customers for their source of deposits. As of September 30, 2026, two customers accounted for over 3% each (3.8% and 3.7%) of our $5.7 billion in deposits. Only these two customer relationships accounted for more than 1% each of our deposits.


Shareholders’ equity at $877.3 million decreased $14.5 million, an annualized 6.4%, for the quarter but increased $46.0 million, or 5.5%, from September 30, 2025. Net unrealized losses on securities, net of deferred taxes, were $96.7 million at September 30, 2026, compared to $68.4 million at June 30, 2026 and $71.1 million at September 30, 2025. CTBI’s annualized dividend yield to shareholders as of September 30, 2026 was 3.83%.


**Asset Quality**


Our total nonperforming loans at $22.5 million at September 30, 2026 decreased $7.3 million for the quarter and $2.2 million from September 30, 2025. Nonaccrual loans at $9.5 million decreased $1.3 million from prior quarter and $6.2 million from September 30, 2025. Accruing loans 90+ days past due at $13.0 million decreased $5.9 million from prior quarter but increased $4.0 million from September 30, 2025. Accruing loans 30-89 days past due at $23.1 million increased $2.8 million from prior quarter and $4.6 million from September 30, 2025. Our loan portfolio management processes focus on the immediate identification, management, and resolution of problem loans to maximize recovery and minimize loss.


We had net loan charge-offs of $6.6 million, an annualized 0.50% of average loans, for the quarter compared to $0.9 million, an annualized 0.07% of average loans, for prior quarter and $2.7 million, an annualized 0.23% of average loans, for the third quarter 2025. The increase in net loan charge-offs was primarily attributable to an $8.7 million commercial relationship previously reported as an accruing loan 90+ past due and in the process of collection. At June 30, 2026, management's analysis suggested that this loan was well secured. During September, the collateral was sold at auction, and we received a significantly lower amount at bid, resulting in a $4.3 million charge-off. Of the net charge-offs for the quarter, $5.0 million were in commercial loans, $1.3 million were in consumer indirect loans, and $0.3 million were in consumer direct loans. Net loan charge-offs for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 were $8.8 million, or an annualized 0.23% of average loans, compared to $5.7 million, or an annualized 0.16% of average loans, for the same period prior year.


**Allowance for Credit Losses**


Our reserve coverage (allowance for credit losses to nonperforming loans) at September 30, 2026 was 289.3% compared to 211.8% at June 30, 2026 and 239.5% at September 30, 2025. Our allowance for credit losses as a percentage of total loans outstanding at September 30, 2026 remained at 1.23% from June 30, 2026 and September 30, 2025.
